entries.source: E. Curzel and G. M. Varanini (eds.), Codex Wangianus. I cartulari della Chiesa trentina, Bologna 2007; Document 45*; also published in Tiroler Urkundenbuch, series I, vol. 2, no. 840
entries.english: In Bolzano, a proceeding under the authority of Count Albert of Tyrol involves a summons before the bishop’s judicial official in a tithe dispute. Federicus de Rosenpacho is listed in the charter.

facts.content: is listed in the charter concerning the tithe dispute.
facts.subject: Friedrich de Rosenpacho
